easy/linear.proof: Exhaustive exact rational/radical tuples; weighted linear coefficients and speed; complete bank distinctness.

moderate/product.proof: Exhaustive exact rational/radical tuples of weighted quadratic coefficients and speed; complete bank distinctness.

moderate/radical.proof: Exhaustive rational banks; weighted constant and sqrt(t) coefficients and speed.

moderate/exponential.proof: Exhaustive slope/speed tuples; exponential transcendence separates different polynomial coefficient banks.

hard/secant.proof: Exhaustive speed/angle tuples; sec² evenness removes sign and translations. Angles ±pi/3, ±pi/4, ±pi/6; pi transcendence separates bank powers.

hard/matched_exponential.proof: Exhaustive speed and exponent-quadratic tuples; positive slope and dx,dy enforce noncollision; exp(integer) transcendence separates coefficient banks.

easy/odd_linear.proof: Normal method bank: a in2..4,c in1..4; a=1 collides and rejects whole bank. Public source raw bank retains anchor a=1,c=2. Fixed y=0; unused d excluded from fingerprint.
